candidates.name: Variational
candidates.summary: Official docs target Q4 2026 for VAR, with no exact date. Variational operates on-chain derivatives, led by Lucas Schuermann and Edward Yu; its site names Dragonfly and Coinbase among investors. Docs intend treasury revenue to buy and burn VAR; this is a plan, not demonstrated token-holder income. The ecosystem reserve is 18%. No public token sale or confirmed listing was identified in the sources checked. Funding amount and independently verified usage remain unconfirmed here. Watch only.
risks: 32% of supply is allocated to a genesis airdrop, fully unlocked at launch. 50% goes to team and investors, locked for 12 months then vesting over at least three years; separate shares are undisclosed.

Total token count, initial circulating supply, official contract, launch price and valuation remain unconfirmed in the sources checked. Derivatives points farming has separate liquidation and loss risks.

Restricted-person rules exclude US and Canadian persons and named territories; local-law eligibility is also required. Australian token eligibility remains unverified. No sale or spot liquidity is established.

candidates.name: AlloX
candidates.summary: Issuer announces a US$1m sale opening 12 October and closing 19 October 2026 at 12:00 UTC; TGE remains unconfirmed and will be separate. AlloX builds AI portfolio and swap tools. Its whitepaper names director Mihai Nicusor Busica and 1bn tokens, with planned governance, discounts and premium access but no contractual profit rights. Zerra confirms its own US$2.5m investment; total US$5m funding is an issuer claim. Watch only; Sonar sale infrastructure is not an exchange listing.
risks: Silver: US$0.065, US$65m FDV, fully unlocked at TGE. Gold: US$0.052, US$52m FDV, 20% at TGE then 12 months linear. Platinum: US$0.039, US$39m FDV, zero at TGE, three-month cliff then 12 months linear.

KYC/KYB and jurisdiction restrictions apply; Australian eligibility is unverified. Commitments are irrevocable, with pro-rata allocation/refunds. Token contract, initial float and spot liquidity remain unverified.

Paid demand and volume quality need independent review: Zerra identified earlier US$6.4bn volume as testnet. Full allocation/unlock reconciliation remains incomplete; do not infer circulating supply or profits from promotional totals.
